# MoveFlew

> MoveFlew is a moving company CRM and dispatch platform with an offline-first mobile field app for crews. Free during beta.

MoveFlew connects lead capture, automated route and fuel pricing, digital proposals with e-signatures and deposits, conflict-free crew and truck dispatch, and an offline-capable PWA for move-day work: photo inspections, signed bills of lading and PDF documents that sync when connectivity returns. It is built for owners and office teams of local and long-distance moving companies.
